title: TikTok Clipper (Paid Trial)
description:
I'm looking for a long term TikTok clipper to help grow my TikTok account.



My content comes from TikTok Lives focused on intuitive guidance, personal growth, and spirituality.



Your primary job isn't editing. It's identifying 
nts people can't scroll past. Editing is how you bring those 
nts to life.



## Paid Trial



I'm inviting five editors to complete the same paid trial.



Each editor will receive the same 2 hour TikTok Live.



Your goal is to identify the strongest 
nts and turn them into engaging short form videos that people genuinely want to watch, comment on, and share.



This is a paid trial.



## Ongoing Role



The editor I choose will receive approximately 10 hours of TikTok Live recordings each week.



Responsibilities:



• Watch the recordings.

• Find the strongest 
nts.

• Create engaging vertical clips.

• Add clean, accurate captions.

• Create strong hooks without using clickbait.

• Deliver videos ready to post on TikTok.



## What I'm Looking For



You understand retention.



You know how to identify emotional 
nts, curiosity, and audience engagement.



You can edit in a modern TikTok style without making the content feel fake or overproduced.



You have excellent English.



You communicate well and meet deadlines.



## Compensation



The paid trial is compensated.



The ongoing role starts at approximately $50 USD per week, with opportunities to grow as the channel grows.



## To Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio.

2. Three examples of your favorite short form edits.

3. One sentence explaining what makes a clip impossible to scroll past.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**PEO & Health Insurance Consulting Firm — Marketing & Social Media VA (Part-Time · Remote)**



This position will likely grow into a full-time role with an uncapped bonus/commission plan on top of hourly pay as the company grows. $0.25 per net new follower + $25/qualified inbound lead. Hourly rate based on experience.



**About AdviceHR**

AdviceHR exists because the health insurance and PEO industry is broken and most companies and their employees are paying the price. We're talking about people who are functionally uninsured, not getting proper medical care, and locked into medical plans they don't understand because a broker prioritized a commission over a family. We're here to change that. We help CEOs, CFOs, and CHROs cut through the noise, stop overpaying, and actually get coverage that works for their people. We build things right, we move with intention, and everything we do is grounded in faith, integrity, and genuine care for the humans on the other side of every decision. If that resonates with you, you'll fit here.



We're hiring a part-time Marketing & Social Media VA who is a self-starter, knows exactly what they're doing, and is ready to bring their full skillset and unlimited creativity to a growing brand. If you thrive with ownership, want to earn extra bonuses based on results, and don't need hand-holding, this is your role.



**What You'll Own**



Your responsibility is to create inbound leads. The below is the game plan we set forth but we are open to suggestions.



*LinkedIn: Personal Brand (Primary Focus)*

- Build and manage a monthly content calendar for the founder's personal LinkedIn profile

- Write, design, and schedule 3–5 posts per week

- Drive daily community engagement: comments, DMs, follower growth

- Generate inbound leads from C-suite decision makers and HR professionals through organic content and engagement strategy

- Support AdviceHR company brand presence as secondary focus

- Track and report growth metrics, engagement, and inbound lead activity



Some posts will be Christian-based about faith and life. Christianity is not a requirement, but you must be comfortable posting this type of content as part of the content strategy.



*Brand & Visual*

- Create graphics and visual assets for LinkedIn posts and campaigns

- Maintain a consistent, professional visual identity

- Manage and optimize the AdviceHR Google Business Profile

- Support general web presence and online visibility



*Future Growth (Phase 2 — Timeline TBD)*

- Podcast guest speaking coordination and media placements

- Newsletter management and subscriber growth

- Expanded content distribution or other recommendations for lead generation



If you have experience with podcast coordination or newsletter management, please mention that in your application as it's relevant to where this role is headed.



**Existing Tools**

LinkedIn, HubSpot, and open to any additional tools needed or tools you bring to the table.



**You Must Have**

- Proven experience managing LinkedIn for B2B executives or professional services firms

- Demonstrated success growing a LinkedIn presence with inbound leads generated or meetings booked from organic content, specific results required

- Portfolio showing measurable follower and engagement growth with real numbers

- Strong written English at an executive level, as you are ghostwriting for a U.S. consultant

- Experience creating graphics for LinkedIn content

- Ability to work independently, take full ownership, and bring creative ideas without being asked

- Reliable internet and partial overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours



HR or insurance industry experience is a plus.



**This Role Is NOT For You If**

- Your LinkedIn experience is B2C, lifestyle, or influencer-focused

- You cannot show specific growth metrics or inbound lead results from past clients or at a minimum provide references.

- You need daily direction to produce content

- You have never written for a U.S.-based executive or business



Please submit your application & apply here: 



*Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 10 business days.*

title: B2B Marketing & Social Media VA
description:
**PEO & Health Insurance Consulting Firm — Marketing & Social Media VA (Part-Time · Remote)**



**About AdviceHR**

AdviceHR exists because the health insurance and PEO industry is broken and most companies and their employees are paying the price. We're talking about people who are functionally uninsured, not getting proper medical care, and locked into medical plans they don't understand because a broker prioritized a commission over a family. We're here to change that. We help CEOs, CFOs, and CHROs cut through the noise, stop overpaying, and actually get coverage that works for their people.  We build things right, we move with intention, and everything we do is grounded in faith, integrity, and genuine care for the humans on the other side of every decision. If that resonates with you, you'll fit here.



We're hiring a part-time Marketing & Social Media VA who is a self-starter, knows exactly what they're doing, and is ready to bring their full skillset and unlimited creativity to a growing brand. If you thrive with ownership, want to earn extra bonuses based on results, and don't need hand-holding, this is your role.



This position will likely grow into a full-time role with an uncapped bonus/commission plan on top of hourly pay as the company grows. $0.25 per net new follower + $25/qualified inbound lead. Hourly rate based on experience.



**What You'll Own**



*LinkedIn: Personal Brand (Primary Focus)*

- Build and manage a monthly content calendar for the founder's personal LinkedIn profile

- Write, design, and schedule 3–5 posts per week

- Drive daily community engagement: comments, DMs, follower growth

- Generate inbound leads from C-suite decision makers and HR professionals through organic content and engagement strategy

- Support AdviceHR company brand presence as secondary focus

- Track and report growth metrics, engagement, and inbound lead activity



Some posts will be Christian-based about faith and life. Christianity is not a requirement, but you must be comfortable posting this type of content as part of the content strategy.



*Brand & Visual*

- Maintain a consistent, professional visual identity

- Manage and optimize the AdviceHR Google Business Profile

- Support general web presence and online visibility



*Future Growth (Phase 2 — Timeline TBD)*

- Podcast guest speaking coordination and media placements

- Newsletter management and subscriber growth

- Expanded content distribution or other recommendations for lead generation



If you have experience with podcast coordination or newsletter management, please mention that in your application as it's relevant to where this role is headed.



**Existing Tools**

LinkedIn, HubSpot, and open to any additional tools needed or tools you bring to the table.



**You Must Have**

- Proven experience managing LinkedIn for B2B executives or professional services firms

- Strong written English at an executive level, as you are ghostwriting for a U.S. consultant

HR or insurance industry experience is a plus.

- Your LinkedIn experience is B2C, lifestyle, or influencer-focused

title: Administrative Assistant for Growing UK Tutoring Business
description:
We are a small and friendly private tuition company in the UK. The director works directly with families, agents and a growing team of tutors in the UK and internationally. She needs a reliable, detail-oriented assistant to take over day-to-day admin so she can focus on tutoring and business development.



This is a long-term and growing role for the right candidate. The director herself used to be an Executive Assistant and so knows what it takes!



We guarantee and pay for a minimum of 5 hours per week (including on up to 4 weeks a year of your holiday) though it could often be more. This is not a fixed-shift role. Tasks, especially parent / tutor messages, come in throughout the week at all hours, so we need someone who deals with them within a reasonable time frame, i.e. usually within no more than half a working day, and sorts urgent requests as needed. We work with a lot of clients in China and can be reasonably flexible to your preferred working hours.



You should expect small amounts of work spread across the week rather than one set block of time. You will need to track and record your working hours which will be paid fortnightly or monthly at your preference. We are happy for you to have another job at the same time.



To apply, please send a CV of no more than one page with a short cover letter which mentions your relevant experience and gives examples of when you have a) managed communications on behalf of a director, b) organised tricky calendars, and c) shown initiative, work ethic and attention to detail that is over and above the usual. When applying for this role, please include the words ‘bright leads’ in the subject line or your application will be automatically filtered out. 



Depending on applications, we may ask for a trial task to be completed in addition to an interview. These will take no more than an hour total and will be paid at the specified rate.



Your role will include:

Multiple diary management

Virtual filing and digitisation

Agent / parent communication

Tutor admin and communication, including onboarding, tracking timesheets and making payments

Creating virtual lesson links

Financials, including tracking lessons, invoicing, expenses

Handling sensitive data

Report and feedback writing and delivery

Homework sourcing and marking

Resource creation

Research, including into educational frameworks

Website updates (using WordPress)

Testimonial collection and publication

Advertising and marketing

Ability to work with initiative and proactive

Process improvement

General admin, including some personal admin

Other tasks as required



You should have / be:

Confident, communicative and proactive

Knowledge or interest in children’s education

Fluent written and spoken English

Genuinely organised and detail-focused

Trustworthy and discrete

Knowledge of data protection

Bachelor’s degree or higher

3+ years in a similar role

Reliable internet and suitable, private working space

title: Genealogy Document Retrieval Coordinator — Full-Time Remote
description:
GENEALOGY DOCUMENT RETRIEVAL COORDINATOR — FULL-TIME REMOTE



Help families recover the historical records needed for Canadian citizenship by descent applications.



We’re hiring a resourceful and highly organized Document Retrieval Coordinator with genealogy, archival research, or historical-record experience. You must also be comfortable using AI tools to work more efficiently while carefully verifying the accuracy of all results.



You’ll manage document requests from beginning to completion, working with government offices, archives, churches, and other record custodians to obtain official copies of vital and historical records.



This is not ordinary data entry. You’ll take ownership of requests, determine the correct ordering process, communicate with record custodians, solve problems, follow up on delays, and ensure every document reaches the correct case.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Order birth, baptism, marriage, death, burial, census, and other historical records

• Work with government agencies, archives, churches, and record repositories

• Review family trees and case information to confirm the correct person and record

• Complete online forms and write professional request
s

• Use approved AI tools to assist with research, organize information, draft correspondence, and improve efficiency

• Independently verify AI-generated information before using it

• Track orders, payments, deadlines, responses, and deliveries

• Follow up on delayed or incomplete requests

• Resolve discrepancies involving names, dates, locations, and family relationships

• Verify that received documents are correct, complete, and usable

• Upload records and maintain accurate case information

• Handle sensitive personal and family information confidentially



EXPECTED WORKLOAD



• Full-time remote position: approximately 40 hours per week

• 6–8 new cases per week

• Approximately five required documents per case

• Around 30–40 document requests per week



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You’ll be a strong candidate if you have:



• Genealogy, family-history, archival, or historical-record research experience

• Familiarity with vital records and family-tree relationships

• Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms

• The ability to use AI efficiently without relying on it blindly

• Exceptional organization and attention to detail

• Strong written English and professional communication skills

• Persistence when records are difficult to obtain

• The ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-ups

• Experience with
, Google Drive, spreadsheets, and online portals

• A reliable computer and internet connection

• The ability to work independently and protect confidential information



Experience with Ancestry, FamilySearch, government archives, church registers, legal documents, immigration cases, or administrative case management is especially valuable.



COMPENSATION



• $4 USD per hour

• $5 USD for each required document successfully obtained and correctly uploaded

• $50 USD for each completed case with all document-ordering work and tracking finalized

• Expected total earnings of approximately $2,500–$3,500 USD per month, depending on performance and case volume



The document bonus is earned when the correct, usable document is received and uploaded—not simply when an order is submitted.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted candidates must be willing to:



• Complete an online reasoning/IQ and attention-to-detail assessment

• Complete a short practical skills assessment

• Participate in a video interview

• Provide at least two verifiable professional references



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. A 2–3 minute video introducing yourself, describing your genealogy or related experience, and explaining why this role interests you



2. A summary of your relevant work experience



3. Details about any genealogy platforms, archives, or record collections you have used



4. A description of the AI tools you have used and how you use them in your work



5. Your weekly availability, time zone, and normal working hours



6. An example of how you manage multiple deadlines and follow-ups



7. Confirmation that you are willing to complete the required assessments



8. Two professional references, including their names, positions, companies,
 addresses, and relationships to you



9. Your computer specifications and a screenshot of a recent internet-speed test



Begin your application with the words “Citizenship Records.”



If you enjoy genealogy, solving historical puzzles, using modern technology, and helping families document their Canadian ancestry, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Whop Community & Content Rewards Manager
description:
Overview



We are seeking a dedicated manager to build and oversee our Whop Content Rewards program. Your mission is to grow our reach by connecting with clippers—creators who repurpose our content—and paying them on a per?view basis through Whop’s built?in system. This role is separate from content creation and social?media management; your focus is on platform setup, creator recruitment, and program administration.



Whop’s Content Rewards allows brands to upload shareable content, set a payment rate per 1?000 views, and connect with creators who distribute that content . Brands d
 how much to pay per view and only pay for actual views received .



Responsibilities



* Set up and maintain a Whop account:

    * Create or manage a Whop business account (free and easy to set up ).

    * Add the Content Rewards app within the Whop dashboard .

* Configure and fund campaigns:

    * Set payment rates per 1?000 views to stay within budget and attract clippers .

    * Ensure funds are available and track spend versus performance.

* Upload and curate content:

    * Work with our creative team to upload videos, demos, or behind?the?scenes clips that are share?worthy .

    * Maintain an organized library of content for clipping.

* Recruit and manage clippers:

    * Identify and select creators who align with our brand; Whop’s platform helps match brands with suitable clippers .

    * Approve submissions and provide feedback to ensure quality and brand alignment.

* Monitor performance:

    * Track views, engagement, and cost per view via Whop’s real?time dashboard .

    * Produce weekly reports summarizing campaign results and insights.

* Community engagement:

    * Communicate with clippers, answer questions, and foster a positive community atmosphere.

    * Stay informed about updates to Whop and industry best practices.



Requirements



* Experience with social media or creator platforms, preferably with user?generated?content programs.

* Strong organizational and communication skills; ability to juggle multiple campaigns and creators.

* Comfort managing budgets and payouts; familiarity with pay?per?view or affiliate?style marketing is a plus.

* Tech?savvy: able to navigate platforms like Whop and learn new tools quickly.

* Self?starter who can operate independently and report results concisely.



Nice?to?Haves



* Prior experience recruiting or managing influencers or creators.

* Familiarity with short?form video trends and what makes content clip?worthy.

* Understanding of marketing analytics and performance metrics.



Compensation



* Hourly Rate: $5–$7 per hour (negotiable based on experience).

* Hours: 15–25 hours per week (flexible, depending on campaign volume).



Application Questions



1. Describe your experience with user?generated content or influencer marketing platforms.

2. Have you managed pay?per?view or affiliate campaigns before? If so, what tools did you use and what were the results?

3. How would you ensure that uploaded content is appealing and “share?worthy” for potential clippers?

4. How do you stay organized while managing multiple creators and budgets?

PAY

$1,000-$2,000/month depending on proven speed and quality. We start with a small paid test batch, then a short paid trial, then full-time.



TO APPLY - applications are ONLY accepted through this form:

title: Operations Manager — Remote Full-Time ($1,400 – $2,500/month)
description:
We are a remote digital marketing company managing multiple online brands. We are looking for an Operations Manager who keeps our systems running, spots problems in the data before anyone else, and fixes processes instead of just following them.



This is a role for someone organized AND analytical. You will not just execute tasks — you will measure whether they work.

What you will do



- Run day-to-day operations across multiple brand accounts: tasks, checklists, deadlines, follow-ups

- Maintain and improve our internal systems (we work heavily with Airtable, Make, Notion, and spreadsheets)

- Track weekly KPIs across accounts, flag anomalies early, and investigate why a number dropped

- Turn messy data from different platforms into clean reports and clear recommendations

- Document processes and build SOPs so nothing depends on one person's memory

- Coordinate with tea
mbers and make sure work actually gets finished, not just assigned



Requirements:



- 2+ years in operations, project coordination, or a similar role

- Strong spreadsheet skills (pivot tables, lookups, formulas) — this will be tested

- Experience with Airtable, Notion, Make/Zapier, or similar tools

- Comfortable reading marketing metrics (conversion rates, CPC, ROAS) and drawing conclusions from them

- Strong written English — clear, structured, no fluff

- Extremely reliable and detail-oriented. A wrong number in a report is a serious problem for you, not a detail.

- You solve problems without waiting for step-by-step instructions



What we offer:



- $1,500 – $2,500/month full-time, depending on experience, paid reliably

- Long-term, stable remote position

- Direct access to the CEO and real influence on how things are done

- 13th month pay and paid time off after probation

- Room to grow into a senior operations role as the company scales



How to apply:



Do not send a CV through this platform. Fill out our application form:

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller — AI Agency (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
THE COMPANY

We are an AI-driven marketing agency that helps established businesses across the United States automate and modernize how they handle inbound leads and calls — primarily through AI receptionist/voice agent systems, with premium website builds as a secondary offer. Our clients are business owners in industries like roofing, HVAC, construction, med spas, chiropractic, and other high-ticket service businesses. These are not startups — they are existing businesses that are already making money and ready to invest in systems that capture more of the revenue they're currently leaving on the table.

We are growing fast and looking for a driven, organized, and persistent appointment setter to join our team remotely.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your primary job is to cold call and set appointments for our sales team with leads we provide for you. Once an appointment is made, you must also notify our sales team with all relevant information to the appointment.



Cold Calling:



Make outbound calls to business owners during US business hours using our dialer

Follow a proven script — we will provide it

Qualify leads — are they an established business with revenue? Are they missing calls or losing leads to voi
? Do they have a weak website or no website? Are they open to improving how they handle inbound calls and leads?

Handle objections confidently and professionally

Book qualified appointments on our sales rep's calendar using a scheduling tool



Follow-Up:



Follow up with leads who did not answer on the first attempt — minimum 3 attempts per lead before marking as no contact

Send follow-up texts or
s to warm leads after initial contact

Re-engage old leads who were interested but did not book

Keep your lead tracker updated in real time — every call logged, every outcome noted



Additional Responsibilities:



Research competitor websites and phone/booking setups for industries you are calling so you can speak intelligently about what an AI receptionist or better website would do for them

Flag any leads who seem especially hot to the sales team immediately

Suggest new industries or niches to target based on what you are seeing in the market

Help build and refine the script over time based on what objections come up most



WHO THIS IS FOR

This person is the right fit if they:



Have done cold calling or outbound sales before and are not afraid of rejection

Are comfortable working inside a dialer and hitting daily call targets

Are extremely organized — you live in your spreadsheet and your calendar

Communicate clearly and professionally in English — written and spoken

Are self-motivated — you do not need someone to tell you to make calls

Are comfortable finding their own leads from scratch every day

Have reliable internet and a quiet place to work

Are available during US business hours — at minimum 9am to 5pm in at least one US time zone

Are motivated by results, not clocked hours — this is a fully commission-based role



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

Do not apply if:



You have never made cold calls before and are not willing to learn fast

You need someone to hand you a list every day

You are looking for a passive or low-effort role, or want guaranteed hourly pay

You give up after one or two rejections

Your English is not strong enough to have a confident business conversation



COMPENSATION

This is a COMMISSION-ONLY role — there is no base or hourly pay.



$10 per qualified appointment that shows up to the call, starting rate

Up to $200 per closed deal, starting rate

Both rates scale up based on performance — consistent high performers earn more per appointment and per close over time

This role has room to grow — the right person can move from setter to closer, with commission on deals they close directly

A top caller can make upwards of 100$ in pure commission



WHAT A GREAT DAY LOOKS LIKE



250–300 dialer calls made daily

5–10 qualified appointments booked daily

Every call logged with outcome and notes

Follow-ups sent to all warm leads from the week prior

Lead tracker fully up to date by end of Friday



Note on performance: call volume is the activity standard, not the success metric. You're evaluated on appointments shown and deals closed — not on dials made. Someone hitting 300 calls with no shows is not outperforming someone hitting 250 calls and booking consistently.

HOW TO APPLY

To be considered you must do the following exactly — applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



Start your application with the subject line or first line: "MALIBU READY"

Write 3–5 sentences about your cold calling experience — be specific, not general

Tell us what industry you would target first and why

Tell us what you would say in the first 10 seconds of a cold call to a roofing company owner

Include your resume or work history



Applications that do not start with "MALIBU READY" will be automatically filtered out. This is intentional. It tells us you read carefully and follow instructions — two things this job requires every single day.

ADDITIONAL TASKS THIS SAME PERSON CAN OWN

Here's everything else you can stack onto this role that a good appointment setter can handle without it becoming a different job:



CRM data entry — logging all calls, outcomes, and follow-ups into a shared sheet or CRM tool

Prospect research — building lead lists for new industries or cities before calling begins

 outreach — sending cold
s to businesses that didn't answer the phone, following a template

Social media lead gen — finding business owners through
 groups, Instagram, or LinkedIn who might be a fit

Script testing — trying different openers and reporting back what gets the best response rate

Appointment confirmation — texting or
ing booked leads 24 hours before their appointment to reduce no-shows

No-show re-engagement — calling back people who missed their appointment to reschedule

Competitor research — identifying businesses in each niche with bad websites or no call-handling system and flagging them as priority targets

Weekly reporting — sending a simple end-of-week report: calls made, appointments booked, no contacts, follow-ups pending

title: Senior Presentation Designer / PowerPoint Specialist Consulting (remote)
description:
We are recruiting experienced PowerPoint designers from established graphic design / presentation design agencies with 5-10 years working experience for top consulting clients. This is a full-time, long-term and 100% remote role. Join our growing international team with designers from Germany, Ghana, India and Philippines! 



Responsibilities:



1) Review and clarify international client requests to meet their unique design requirements.

2) Create consultant-grade PowerPoint slides with clarity and professionalism - this includes complex illustrations and advanced analytical charts / graphs / diagrams with an extreme level of detail and creativity.

3) Collaborate with the team to continuously improve design skills and share best practices.

4) Consistently train to improve both communication and design abilities.

5) Meet deadlines efficiently while managing time effectively in a remote environment

6) Stick to our processes, guidelines and design principles + procedures 



Preferred candidate profile:



1) Minimum 5 years of professional experience in an established agency as PowerPoint designer, preferably served Strategy Consulting clients (McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte etc.)

2) Exceptional comprehension and analytical skills in reading, writing, and speaking international business English.

3) Expert knowledge in PowerPoint (usage of add-ins, shortcuts etc)

4) Outstanding attention to detail

5) A reliable internet connection

6) Passion for problem-solving, communication, and creative design

7) Experience with AI design tools in PPT is a plus



Selection process (IMPORTANT):



The role is demanding and very selective.



STAGE 1: Upload your design portfolio with recent PPT examples you've worked on (before-after i.e. input from client and your output - content and logos can be anonymized!). Candidates w/o design portfolio will be declined.



STAGE 2: Shortlisted candidates will receive a design challenge (creating a few slides about yourself in a specified design).



STAGE 3: Selected candidates will be invited for a first video interview which will include a live PPT challenge.



STAGE 4: Final candidates go through final video interview to negotiate contract terms.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Position Overview:



As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.





Pay Range: $8 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.





About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission.





Objectives:

• Manage and organize the CEO's daily schedule, including meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.

• Act as a gatekeeper, screening and prioritizing communications to the CEO.

• Coordinate and facilitate communication between the CEO and internal/external stakeholders.

• Anticipate the CEO's needs and proactively handle tasks to ensure optimal time management.

• Coordinate special projects and initiatives as assigned by the CEO.





Competencies:

• Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with keen attention to detail.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion in handling sensitive information.

• Proficient in using Microsoft Office and Google Suites.

• Familiarity with scheduling software; experience with additional productivity tools is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.





Equipment Requirements:

• Must own a reliable computer or laptop capable of handling administrative tasks efficiently.

• Must own and actively use an iPhone and/or MacBook or Mac computer for efficient communication and task management.

• High-speed internet connection to support video calls, cloud-based collaboration, and remote work.





Physical Requirements:

• Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.



Benefits:

• Growth opportunities in a well-established company.

• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

• Opportunity for advancement within the company.

• A supportive and collaborative work environment.

• Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time).

• Paid vacation.





How to Apply:



If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its tea
mbers and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.




/internationalcareers



Power Plus Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds to apply.



Join us at Power Plus Systems, LLC, and be part of our continued success as we embark on the next 20 years of excellence in residential electrical contracting!

title: Course Content & Digital Production Specialist
description:
# Course Content & Digital Production Specialist



## About the Role



We are looking for a creative and highly organised **Course Content & Digital Production Specialist** to help build and launch our online training platform, **Provider Academy**.



This role is responsible for transforming our course content into a polished, engaging learning experience by creating visual assets, editing videos, producing animations, and building the course inside our learning platform.



## Key Responsibilities



* Design professional slide graphics and visual assets for training modules.

* Create simple animations and motion graphics for course presentations.

* Edit course videos using AI editing tools and traditional video editing software.

* Combine Loom recordings, screen recordings, graphics, captions, transitions, and other media into polished training videos.

* Create and organise downloadable course resources, templates, worksheets, and supporting materials.

* Build and structure the course inside the selected learning management system (LMS) or course platform.

* Ensure consistent branding, formatting, and design across all course content.

* Upload and organise lessons, quizzes, downloads, and course modules.

* Collaborate with the team to improve the learning experience and suggest creative ideas to enhance engagement.

* Maintain organised project files and meet agreed production deadlines.



## Desired Skills & Experience



* Experience with video editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar).

* Experience creating presentations and visual assets in PowerPoint, Canva, Figma, Adobe Illustrator, or similar.

* Experience using AI tools for video editing, image generation, voice enhancement, and content production.

* Experience building online courses within platforms such as Kajabi, Thinkific, Teachable, LearnWorlds, GoHighLevel, or similar.

* Strong attention to detail and design consistency.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and work independently.

* Excellent communication and time management skills.



## Bonus Skills



* Motion graphics or animation experience.

* Basic graphic design and branding knowledge.

* Experience creating educational or e-learning content.

* Familiarity with AI productivity tools and automation.

* Copywriting or instructional design experience.



To apply, please send through examples of your experience and previous work relating to the skills and responsibilities listed above.



Thank you, Jess.

title: Chat Intake Training Manager
description:
About Juvo Leads

Juvo Leads is one of the fastest-growing live chat and legal intake companies in the United States. For more than 11 years, we have helped law firms connect with prospective clients through live chat, inbound call handling, appointment scheduling, and intake services.



Our primary focus is serving law firms nationwide, helping them create exceptional first impressions and convert more qualified prospects into clients.



While much of the industry continues to move toward automation, AI, and chatbots, our philosophy remains simple:

Butts in Seats. Not Bots in the Cloud.



We believe that when someone is searching for legal help, they deserve to interact with a real person. Every conversation we handle is powered by a trained human tea
mber—not artificial intelligence. Our commitment to genuine human interaction is what sets us apart and has fueled our growth for more than a decade.



As we continue to expand, we're building a world-class remote workforce capable of delivering exceptional service at scale. We are looking for leaders who are passionate about developing people, improving performance, and creating systems that help employees succeed.



If you're excited about building high-performing remote teams, developing talent, and creating measurable business impact through training and coaching, we'd love to meet you.



Overview

We are seeking a Training Manager to own the onboarding, development, certification, and ongoing education of our remote chat agent workforce. This role is responsible for ensuring every new hire receives a consistent, high-quality training experience and is fully prepared to succeed in production.



The Training Manager will design and deliver training programs, oversee agent readiness, partner with Operations and Quality teams to address performance gaps, and continuously improve learning initiatives that drive quality, efficiency, and client outcomes. This position is accountable not only for training delivery, but for the measurable success of agents after training.



The ideal candidate has experience building and managing remote training programs, coaching adult learners, developing curriculum, and creating scalable processes that support rapid organizational growth.



 Key Responsibilities: 



New Hire Training & Onboarding

  * Own the end-to-end onboarding and training experience for all new chat agents.

  * Design and deliver structured onboarding programs that prepare agents for legal intake and live chat responsibilities.

  * Ensure all new hires complete training, certification, and graduation requirements within established timelines.

  * Conduct readiness assessments and certify agents before transition to production teams.

  * Facilitate seamless handoffs between Training, Operations, and Quality teams.



Training Program Development

  * Design, implement, and continuously improve training programs for new and existing agents.

  * Develop lesson plans, training materials, SOPs, assessments, simulations, certifications, and knowledge base content.

  * Ensure training content remains current, accurate, and aligned with operational processes and client requirements.

  * Create scalable training systems capable of supporting company growth and new client launches.

  * Incorporate adult learning principles and instructional design best practices into all training initiatives.



Coaching & Employee Development

  * Deliver engaging virtual training sessions using a variety of learning methods and technologies.

  * Provide coaching, mentorship, and developmental feedback to employees throughout their tenure.

  * Partner with supervisors to identify employee skill gaps and create targeted development plans.

  * Build refresher training, continuing education, and performance improvement programs.

  * Support career growth initiatives, internal promotions, and leadership development pathways.



Performance Assessment & Quality Improvement

  * Develop evaluation tools to measure trainee comprehension, readiness, and performance.

  * Track post-training performance to evaluate training effectiveness.

  * Analyze quality trends, recurring errors, and operational performance metrics to identify training opportunities.

  * Collaborate with Quality Assurance and Operations teams to reduce performance gaps and improve outcomes.

  * Ensure retraining initiatives are deployed quickly when performance concerns emerge. 



Collaboration & Program Management

  * Partner closely with Operations Leadership, Quality Assurance, and Client Services teams.

  * Support new client launches, process updates, script changes, and system enhancements through training initiatives.

  * Maintain accurate reporting on training completion, certifications, graduation rates, retention, and performance outcomes.

  * Establish best practices for knowledge transfer, coaching, documentation, and employee development.

  * Build and manage scalable training processes as the company continues to grow.



 Qualifications 



  Required 

  * Bachelor's degree in Education, Training & Development, Communications, Psychology, Business, Human Resources, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

  * Minimum 3 years of experience designing, delivering, and managing training programs in a fully remote environment with 50-100 employees. 

  * Proven experience onboarding, coaching, developing, and upskilling remote employees with teams of 50-100. 

  * Experience creating and maintaining virtual training curricula, certification programs, assessments, knowledge bases, SOPs, and continuing education programs.

  * Experience using remote training and knowledge management platforms such as Trainual, NotebookLM, Loom, Google Workspace, LMS platforms, testing tools, and virtual meeting software.

  * Experience in Live chat, Customer Service, Legal Intake, Contact Center Operations, Sales, Appointment Setting, or other performance-driven environments in the U.S. market. 

  * Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, coaching techniques, and performance management.

  * Demonstrated ability to provide performance coaching, career development guidance, and individualized improvement plans.

  * Experience partnering with Quality Assurance and Operations teams to identify skill gaps and implement training solutions.

  * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  * Strong organizational, project management, and time management skills.

  * Ability to simplify complex concepts into engaging, actionable, and measurable learning experiences.

  * Data-driven mindset with experience using performance metrics, quality scores, and operational KPIs to evaluate training effectiveness.

  * Experience working with cross-functional, multinational teams supporting U.S.-based clients. 



 Preferred 

  * Experience in Legal Intake, Law Firm Operations, Legal Marketing, or Legal terminology.

  * Experience training and coaching remote teams in Live Chat, Customer Service, Contact Center, Intake, Sales, or Appointment-setting environments.

  * Experience building certification programs, mentorship initiatives, career progression frameworks, and leadership development programs.

  * Background in instructional design, learning and development, organizational development, or corporate training.

  * Experience creating video-based, self-paced, instructor-led, and blended learning programs.

  * Experience developing manager training and performance improvement programs.

  * Experience working in a startup, high-growth, or rapidly scaling organization.

  * Certifications in Instructional Design, Learning & Development, Adult Learning, Coaching, Scrum, Agile, or related disciplines.

  * Extreme sense of ownership, pride and urgency- we move fast and are accountable to ourselves, our customers and our team. 



What Success Looks Like

The Training Manager owns the complete employee learning lifecycle, from onboarding through ongoing development. Success is measured not by training delivered, but by employee readiness, consistency, performance, and retention.



 New Hire Training & Onboarding 

  * All new hires complete onboarding, certification, and graduation requirements within established timelines.

  * New hires receive a consistent training experience regardless of trainer, start date, or training cohort.

  * Training classes are structured, organized, and delivered on schedule.

  * New hires demonstrate readiness before being released to production through documented assessments and certifications.

  * Agents are successfully transitioned into production teams with clear supervisor handoffs and performance expectations.



Performance & Development

  * New hires achieve expected quality and productivity metrics within established ramp periods.

  * Quality trends, recurring errors, and performance gaps are proactively identified and addressed through targeted training initiatives.

  * Refresher training and continuing education programs are delivered consistently.

  * Career development pathways support employee growth, internal promotions, and leadership development.



Training Program Ownership

  * Training materials, SOPs, certifications, knowledge bases, and assessments remain current and aligned with operational requirements.

  * New client launches, process updates, and operational changes are incorporated into training before impacting production performance.

  * Training programs scale effectively to support company growth and hiring demands.

  * Strong partnerships are maintained across Operations, Quality, and Leadership teams to continuously improve employee performance and client outcomes.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

   * Onboarding & Graduation

         * 95%+ New Hire Training Completion Rate

         * 95%+ Training Completion Within Established Timelines

         * 90%+ Certification Pass Rate

         * 90%+ Graduation Rate

         * 100% Readiness Assessments Completed Prior to Production Release



Retention & Performance

         * 85%+ New Hire 30-Day Retention Rate

         * New hires achieve expected productivity and quality benchmarks within established ramp schedules

         * Measurable reduction in repeat QA errors month-over-month

          * 100% Completion of Required Retraining Initiatives



Program Management

  * Training materials updated within 3 days of approved process changes

  * 100% Training readiness for new client launches and operational rollouts

  * Monthly reporting on training completion, certification results, retention, quality trends, and development initiatives



Ownership

   The Training Manager is responsible for:

         * New hire onboarding and orientation

         * Curriculum development and maintenance

         * Training delivery and facilitation

         * Certification and graduation processes

         * Production readiness assessments

         * Transition of agents into operational teams

         * Ongoing employee development and career coaching

         * Refresher training and retraining initiatives

         * Training documentation and knowledge management

         * Measuring and improving performance outcomes after training



 Benefits & Perks 

At Juvo Leads, we believe great people deserve a great place to work. We're a fast-growing, fully remote team that values collaboration, accountability, and a positive work environment where your ideas and contributions matter.



Compensation & Schedule

  * Pay: $9.00 USD per hour

  * Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST

  * Some evenings and weekends will be required to support training initiatives within our 24/7 operation.

  * Bi-weekly payments via Wise



Premium Pay

  * Overtime: 1.5x hourly rate for hours worked over 80 in a pay period

  * Holiday Pay: 1.5x hourly rate for hours worked on designated company holidays after 8 hours worked



Paid Time Off

  * 10 hours of PTO accrued per month

  * Any unused accrued PTO will be paid out on the first payroll of the calendar year.



Health & Technology

  * $80/month HMO stipend

  * $200 Welcome Technology Bonus

  * $100 Annual Equipment Bonus



Why You'll Love Working Here

*  100% remote position

*  Opportunity to grow with one of the fastest-growing legal intake companies in the United States

*  Collaborative, supportive, and people-first culture

*  Comprehensive training documentation, SOPs, and knowledge management resources to set you up for success

*  Opportunity to make a meaningful impact by building and improving our training programs

*  Work alongside talented professionals across the United States and Latin America

*  A company that values innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and promoting from within



If you’re someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and knows how to stay ahead of the game, we want to hear from you.

Send your application to 
 and be part of our growing team at Juvo Leads! (as we do not check OLJ daily)

Please use the subject line “JUVO LEADS - CHAT INTAKE TRAINING MANAGER” when submitting your application. Thank you!

title: Part-Time E-Commerce Virtual Assistant
description:

title: Tiktok Shop and Shopify Manager
description:
ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE IN TIKTOK SHOP AND SHOPIFY



This seat owns three pillars: running the Purevia TikTok Shop end to end, handling all customer service and order support across the brand, and publishing and scheduling organic content across the brand’s social channels. It consolidates a sales-channel operations role and a customer-facing support role into one position.



2. Responsibilities

2.1 TikTok Shop Management

• Maintain TikTok Shop Seller Center: account health, compliance, and policy standing.

• Product listing and catalog management: titles, images, pricing, variants, and stock sync.

• Manage TikTok Shop orders end to end: confirmation, fulfillment handoff, and tracking.

• Monitor TikTok Shop performance: GMV, conversion, violations, and review score.

• Run affiliate and creator campaigns and coordinate sample orders flowing through the Shop, including the Sideshift review-and-refund flow.

• Keep listings aligned with FDA structure and function claim language. No treatment claims, no before-and-after imagery on TikTok.

• Act as the final compliance check before any listing or update is published on TikTok. If supplied copy contains a non-compliant claim, hold publication and flag to the Founder rather than publishing it.

• Flag Shop issues such as suspensions, listing rejections, and payout holds to the Founder the same day.

2.2 Customer Service & Order Support

• Respond to all customer inquiries within 24 hours across
 
 Shopify, and social DMs. Weekend inquiries are answered no later than the next business day.

• Process refunds, returns, exchanges, and cancellations per policy, within the authority limits in Section 5.

• Resolve order issues: tracking problems, lost or delayed shipments, wrong or missing items, via ParcelWILL.

• Support chargeback and dispute responses through Chargeflow: evidence gathering and customer outreach to resolve before escalation.

• Monitor and respond to public reviews across Shopify, TrustPilot, TikTok, and Instagram within 48 hours, using approved brand voice and compliant language only.

• Never provide medical advice or make health claims in any customer reply. Use approved response templates. For health or safety questions, including use while breastfeeding, direct the customer to consult their physician.

• Never contradict the honest 8 to 12 week timeline. Do not promise faster results to resolve a complaint.

• Maintain a customer feedback log of recurring complaints, refund reasons, and product issues, and surface themes weekly.

2.3 Organic Social Posting & Scheduling

• Schedule and publish organic content to TikTok, Instagram, and other brand social channels on the agreed cadence and calendar.

• Publish creative supplied by the creative team. This role posts and schedules; it does not create hooks or direct creative.

• Write captions and on-platform copy in brand voice and compliant language: structure and function only, no before-and-after on TikTok, never contradicting the 8 to 12 week timeline.

• Maintain a posting calendar and coordinate timing with launches, promos, and
 sends.

• Engage with comments and DMs on posts in line with the customer service and moderation duties above.

• Track basic organic performance (views, engagement, follower growth) and include it in the weekly report.

2.4 Reporting

• Weekly summary every Monday: TikTok Shop numbers, ticket volume, refund and return rate, recurring issues, and blockers.

• Daily standup, Monday to Friday: done, blocked, next.

• Escalate revenue-affecting issues (Shop suspension, refund spikes, dispute surge) to the Founder the same day.

description:

title: Senior Creative Strategist – €30K+/mo Ad Spend, Scaling Fast
description:
About the role

We're a Dutch direct-response DTC brand doing €30K+/month on Meta and scaling fast. One founder has been running paid media and creative solo, and creative testing has become the bottleneck on growth. This role exists to take that off the founder's plate entirely and turn it into a real, repeatable system.

You'll own the full creative testing loop end to end: from angle and persona research, through briefing and production (via a freelance editor bench), to launch, analysis, and iteration. This isn't a "make some ads" role, it's a strategy role that happens to require production oversight.



What you'll do

You run the full testing loop: ideation to brief to production to launch to analysis to next iteration, nothing sits idle waiting on you. You build and maintain an awareness/sophistication-stage model based on Schwartz that d
 what gets tested and when, so every creative decision is traceable to a stage instead of a hunch. You brief and manage a bench of freelance video editors and enforce AI-tool fluency (Runway, Veo, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Midjourney) and voiceover/language quality as a baseline. You mine reviews, competitor reviews, and forums for language and objections and turn that into new personas and angles. You report on what's working, what's not, and why, with CPA/ROAS by angle and stage, not just a spend dashboard. You flag where the homepage or PDP is undermining ad performance and work with the founder to fix it.



What we're looking for

Someone who has run creative testing against real ad spend, not just made content. Someone who understands direct-response fundamentals: awareness stages, sophistication stages, mechanism-led positioning. Someone comfortable managing freelancers and contractors, not just executing personally. Someone fluent with AI creative tools or fast to pick them up. Someone who can read a metrics dashboard and turn it into a next test, not just a report.



Compensation

$1,600/month flat. A performance-based structure on top of this is open for discussion once a track record is established.

 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation

title: B2B Sales Representative
description:
B2B Sales Representative

Remote (global, English-speaking) · Full-time · 3–5 yrs outbound experience



Hears makes premium hearing protection that people actually want to wear. We started because we couldn't find earplugs we'd be caught dead in at a festival, so we spent two years building our own with world-class acoustic engineers and audiologists. The product won an iF Design Award. DJs, producers and venues trust it. Our B2B side — festivals, clubs, corporates, retail, music industry — has quietly become one of the most exciting parts of the business.

It's also the part with the most upside left to capture. That's why we're hiring.





The role

You're the second pair of boots on the ground for B2B. You'll work directly alongside our B2B Manager, Luuk, and report into the founding team. The job is simple to describe and hard to do well: open new doors, build a pipeline, close deals, and make clients come back. 



Your day looks roughly like this:

- Cold outreach. LinkedIn,
 and phone. Real conversations, not blasted templates. You'll be building sequences, testing angles, and getting on calls with people who didn't know they needed us yesterday.

- Owning your pipeline. From first touch to signed deal. You'll qualify,send samples, negotiate and close — with full support from us, but you run the process.

- Representing Hears. You're often the first human contact a prospect has with the brand. How you write, call and follow up sets the tone. We care about this a lot.

- Working five segments: venues & hospitality, festivals & events, corporate wellbeing, pharmacies & retail, and music industry (labels, studios, artist teams). You'll learn fast which ones convert hardest for you and we'll lean in.

- Feeding the machine. Clean CRM hygiene, weekly numbers, honest reporting on what's working and what isn't. We don't need theatre — we need signal.

- Running the admin side. Keeping the CRM tidy, logging every touchpoint, tracking deal stages honestly, sending samples on time, following up when you said you would. Half of B2B sales is just doing what you said you'd do, on time. This includes invoicing, sending quotes, forwarding orders to fulfillment and providing clients with status updates. We need someone who treats that as part of the craft, not a chore.





What we're looking for

Mid-level. 3–5 years of proven outbound sales and account management experience in B2B. We're not hiring on a script — we're hiring on a track record. If you've consistently hit or beaten quota in an outbound role, we want to talk.



Specifically:

- 3–5 years in B2B sales or business development, with at least two of those running outbound (not just inbound or account management).

- Numbers you can point to. Pipeline generated, deals closed, target attainment, honest forecasting. We'll ask.

- Native or near-native English, written and spoken. Additional languages (Dutch, German, Spanish, French) are a strong plus.

- Fluent with the modern sales stack — Notion LinkedIn Sales Navigator,
 sequencing tools, Apollo / Lusha / equivalent. -- You don't need to know our exact tools; you need to be the kind of person who learns them in a week.

- Comfortable on the phone. A lot of this role still happens on calls. If cold calling makes you flinch, this isn't the right fit.

- Self-driven and remote-ready. You'll be working across time zones with a small team. We measure output, not hours — which only works if you're someone who actually runs themselves.

- Bonus points for experience in events, music, hospitality, wellness or premium consumer brands. Genuine personal interest in any of those worlds counts.

- Confident and authentic seller. We don't work with scripts and tacky sales tactics you see on socials these days. People buy from people they trust, and the product does half the selling already.



What you get

- Competitive base + uncapped commission. The more you close, the more you make. Simple.

- A real growth path. This is the second B2B hire and you d
 your growth path. The person who shows up and performs has a clear shot at building and leading a team within 12–18 months.

- Full remote. Work from wherever you do your best work, as long as you can overlap meaningfully with European hours.

- A product people are actually excited to hear about. Cold outreach is hard. It's a lot less hard when prospects reply with "oh, you guys made these? I love them."

- Direct access to founders. No layers. You'll work closely with Luuk on B2B and have a direct line to us on anything that needs unblocking.



How we work

- Direct, honest, low on corporate theatre. We care about output and we care about the brand. We move fast, we say what we mean, and we expect the same back. If that sounds like your kind of place, you'll like it here.



How to apply

Fill out this Notion Form: 



- Your CV — short and specific is better than long and generic.

- A short note (no cover letter required) telling us: 1.  The deal you're most proud of closing, and which of our five segments you'd attack first and why. 2. A client you kept despite something going wrong, and what you did about it. 

- Optional but appreciated: a 60-second Loom of you pitching a product you love. Doesn't have to be ours. We just want to see how you sound.



We read everything. 



— Nick & Bob

Co-founders, Hears

About the role

title: Accounts & Finance Administration Support - Book Keeper
description:
Accounts & Finance Administration Support



Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Accounts & Finance Administrator to manage the company’s day-to-day invoicing, payment processing, reconciliations, and financial administration across stores, agencies, partners and suppliers.

This role is responsible for ensuring accurate financial records, timely payment processing, account reconciliation, and maintaining clean and up-to-date data within Xero and banking platforms. The position is responsible for the operational finance processes and maintaining strong communication with agency finance teams, commercial teams and sales teams.



Key Responsibilities

Accounts Receivable & Payables

• Creating and applying credits for agencies and invoice adjustments as required.

• Upload and maintain all paid invoices within the Xero platform. Ensure invoice is attached to the reconciled line item to allow later reference to the invoice should it be required.

• Send monthly invoices out for every campaign applicable the last day of the month. All invoices should be saved in drafts, until this date.

• Monthly statement of accounts to be sent to all clients where an invoice/s is outstanding. To be sent 10th of each month.

• Follow up and contact all agency payments that are overdue

• Request remittances from all agencies that have invoices due that month. Request to be sent 2nd week of month.

• Allocate all Banking payments/ XERO payments to invoices payable, detailing the date of payment.

• Reconcile all receivable (agency) and payable (stores/partners/suppliers) in Xero against applicable invoices and/or payments as shown in Banking account.

• Send remittance advice to stores once payments are processed in Xero and Bank. This requires daily checking and updating Xero bills.

Payment Processing & Reconciliations

• Bi-monthly payment entries for directors approval of banking transaction payments.

• Create bills in Xero for each store payment for adhoc (one off months) and reoccurring (QTR). 

• Remove paid stores from Xero in bills-paid once remittances are completed to avoid duplicate payments. Every payment to be removed, then void of out bills.

• Maintain accurate financial records and investigate discrepancies where required.

Financial Administration & System Maintenance

• Enter campaign booking confirmations into Xero via per campaign, per monthly invoices.

• Cross-check monthly invoices against sales tracker to ensure billing accuracy. Sales team to be informed of any discrepancies.

• Remove closed or inactive stores from Xero and Banking systems (ensure this is done – check required)

• Maintain clean and accurate financial databases and payment records.

• Support ongoing financial reporting and administration requirements.

 

What You’ll Bring

• Experience in accounts administration, bookkeeping, or finance coordination.

• Strong working knowledge of Xero and banking reconciliation processes.

• High attention to detail and strong organisational skills.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

Set up and configure Lasso Checkout and integrate it with our Shopify store, including the backend connection, theme code snippets, and payment/confirmation page flows

A brief description of at least one Shopify + Lasso (or comparable third-party checkout) integration you've completed, including your specific role

About Us



At Helper Heroes, we’re on a mission to provide exceptional care and support to home care agencies in America. We believe in creating a true partnership where our employees act and feel like a true member of the American team they are matched with. Our goal is to help them create a compassionate, innovative, and efficient care experience for their clients and their families. To achieve this, we’re looking for a Helper Hero to join our team and help us shine even brighter!



About You



What sets us apart is YOU. You’re not just any virtual assistant —you’re a Helper Hero! If you’re passionate about making a difference, have a knack for organization, and thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment, you’re who we are looking for. If you’re the kind of person who loves tackling behind-the-scenes tasks with a smile, ensuring that our clients' caregivers and clients receive the best possible support, apply today!



Job Overview



We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Recruiter to support recruitment, caregiver onboarding, and administrative tasks for a growing home care business. This role is ideal for someone with experience in healthcare recruitment and a passion for

streamlining operations. You will work closely with the owner to alleviate their workload, enabling them to focus on business growth and client care.

- Manage end-to-end caregiver recruitment: screen applicants, schedule interviews, and coordinate orientation/training.

- Process onboarding documentation via ADP Workforce (e.g., electronic I-9s, employee handbook distribution).

- Track and ensure completion of state-mandated caregiver training (e.g.,via Active Insights).



2. Administrative Support



- Answer inbound calls during peak hours and manage voicemails/lead inquiries.

- Assist with client intake calls and referral source coordination.

- Provide general administrative support (e.g., scheduling, data entry).



3. Systems & Collaboration



- Utilize platforms like WellSky or Axiscare (training provided) to streamline workflows.

- Collaborate with the owner to refine processes and maintain organization.



Qualifications:



- Excellent written/verbal communication (fluent English).

- Strong organizational and time-management abilities.

- Proficiency with CRM systems, email management, and cloud-based tools (e.g., Google Drive).

- Proactive mindset—anticipate needs before they arise.

- Proven experience in recruitment, specifically in healthcare or home care staffing.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with candidates and team members.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.

- Familiarity with recruitment platforms and CRM tools

- A positive attitude, sense of humor, and a passion for helping others.



Attributes of a Successful Helper Hero:



- Empathy: You genuinely care about people and want to make a difference in their lives.

- Organization: You’re a master of multitasking and can keep everything running smoothly.

- Communication: You speak impeccable English. You’re a clear and friendly communicator, both written and verbal.

- Problem Solver: You can see the big picture when resolving complex issues and follow through until you reach full resolution.

- Self Starter: You work effectively without supervision and follow processes precisely.

- Reliability: You’re dependable, punctual, and always ready to step up when needed.



Why You’ll Love Working with Us:



- Competitive Base Pay: $6.50/hr for the first 6 months. (Among the highest in the homecare industry)

- Make a Difference: You’ll play a key role in ensuring that clients receive the best care possible.

- Growth Opportunities: As we grow, so will you! There’s plenty of room for advancement and learning.

- Fun & Supportive Team: We’re a tight-knit group that values collaboration, compassion, and a good laugh.



Ready to Be a Hero?



If you’re excited about the opportunity to join our team, where you’ll be appreciated, have a sense of purpose and inclusion and are willing to help us create a brighter, more compassionate care experience, we can’t wait to hear from you! Apply today and let’s make a difference together.

title: Social Media Content Creator & Multimedia Editor - Luxury Brands | Video, Carousels, Static Design & Multi-Platform
description:
Luxury Brands | Video, Carousels, Static Design & Multi-Platform Content



About Us



We are a growing creative and marketing company working with premium and luxury brands across:



* Luxury events

* Hospitality

* Food and beverage

* Medical aesthetics

* Wellness

* Education and nonprofit organizations

* Real estate

* Founder and personal brands

* High-end service businesses



Our clients operate in elevated environments and often serve discerning, affluent, and high-profile audiences. Their social media and digital presence must reflect the same level of quality, sophistication, and credibility as their businesses.



We are looking for a highly skilled **Social Media Content Creator and Multimedia Editor** who can transform raw footage, professional photography, phone content, brand assets, written content, and creative direction into a consistent volume of polished, luxury-quality content.



This is not solely a video-editing role.



You must be equally comfortable creating sophisticated carousels, static graphics, short-form videos, long-form videos, event content, and platform-specific creative.



Our internal team will lead the brand strategy, campaign direction, messaging priorities, content themes, and overall marketing strategy. Your responsibility will be to bring that direction to life through exceptional design, editing, storytelling, and creative production.



This is a long-term position with the opportunity to grow into a lead creative role as our client portfolio expands.



---



## Your Primary Responsibility



Your primary responsibility will be to turn raw footage, photography, brand assets, written content, and creative direction into a consistent volume of polished content across multiple brands and platforms.



You should be able to open a folder containing raw videos, professional photography, phone footage, event media, and existing brand assets and determine:



* Which assets are strongest

* What content can be created

* How the content should be structured

* Which format is most appropriate

* How the visuals should be edited or designed

* How one set of assets can become multiple pieces of content

* How content should be adapted for different platforms

* How to preserve the identity of each individual brand



We are looking for someone who can execute at a high level without requiring step-by-step creative instructions for every asset.



---



## What You Will Be Creating



Projects may include:



* Instagram Reels

* Instagram carousels

* Static social media posts

* Instagram Stories

* TikTok videos

* YouTube Shorts

* Long-form YouTube videos

* Video teasers and trailers

* Pinterest graphics and video Pins

*
 posts and videos

* LinkedIn graphics and video content

* Event announcements

* Event recap videos

* Event recap carousels

* Brand launch content

* Partnership announcements

* Promotional campaigns

* Food and beverage content

* Hospitality and destination content

* Medical aesthetics content

* Educational and authority-building content

* Product and service showcases

* Founder and personal-brand content

* Testimonials and case studies

* Behind-the-scenes content

* Campaign covers and thumbnails

* Content repurposed from long-form footage

* Multiple social media assets developed from one raw-content folder



You may work across several brands, each with its own visual identity, audience, and creative direction.



---



## Luxury Creative Standard



Every brand in our portfolio operates within a premium or luxury environment.



The content you create must reflect the quality, sophistication, and level of clientele these businesses serve.



Luxury experience or a strong luxury-focused portfolio is highly preferred.



You must understand that luxury content is not simply:



* Gold typography

* Black backgrounds

* Slow-motion footage

* Dramatic music

* Excessive transitions

* Generic templates

* AI-generated mansions or models

* Applying the same aesthetic to every client



True luxury creative requires:



* Refined visual judgment

* Elegant typography

* Strong composition

* Intentional pacing

* Sophisticated color grading

* High-quality image and footage selection

* Clean editorial layouts

* Strategic use of negative space

* Controlled motion and transitions

* Attention to lighting, texture, sound, and detail

* Visual restraint

* Consistency across every touchpoint



The final work should feel:



* Elevated

* Editorial

* Intentional

* Sophisticated

* Polished

* Modern

* Credible

* Distinctive to the brand



It should never feel:



* Cheap

* Cluttered

* Overdesigned

* Generic

* Template-driven

* Outdated

* Excessively flashy

* Obviously AI-generated

* Inconsistent with the brand



You must be able to interpret luxury differently across industries.



For example:



* **Medical aesthetics** should feel clean, credible, modern, refined, and clinically sophisticated.

* **Hospitality** should feel aspirational, immersive, experiential, and desirable.

* **Luxury events** should communicate exclusivity, atmosphere, energy, and anticipation.

* **Food and beverage** should feel sensory, rich, elegant, and visually considered.

* **Education and nonprofit content** should feel human, credible, compelling, and emotionally resonant without losing visual quality.

* **Founder and personal-brand content** should feel polished, authoritative, authentic, and current.



Each client must maintain its own identity. We are not looking for someone who applies the same templates, fonts, effects, or editing style to every brand.



---



## Design and Video Standards



You should have an exceptional eye for:



* Graphic design

* Typography

* Visual hierarchy

* Composition

* Layout

* Image selection

* Video editing

* Storytelling

* Pacing

* Color grading

* Lighting

* Music selection

* Sound design

* Motion graphics

* Caption design

* Brand consistency

* Fine details



You understand how to make content feel premium without overproducing it.



You should also understand how to create content that captures attention while maintaining an elevated brand identity.



The strongest candidate will know when to:



* Use restraint

* Let footage breathe

* Create faster-paced edits

* Use subtle motion

* Build anticipation

* Lead with a strong visual

* Use typography as part of the storytelling

* Remove unnecessary effects

* Choose quality over visual noise



---



## Platform Awareness



You are not expected to lead our overall social media strategy, analytics, reporting, or conversion strategy.



However, you must have a strong working knowledge of the platforms you are creating for and understand that content should not simply be resized and posted identically everywhere.



You should understand the creative differences between:



### Instagram



* Reels

* Carousels

* Stories

* Static posts

* Covers and thumbnails

* Saveable and shareable content

* Strong visual cohesion

* Current editing and design expectations



### YouTube



* YouTube Shorts

* Long-form video

* Audience retention

* Opening hooks

* Pacing

* Thumbnails

* Titles and visual structure

* Repurposing long-form footage into short-form clips



### TikTok



* Platform-native pacing

* Strong openings

* Authenticity

* Current formats

* Trend adaptation

* Fast audience retention



### Pinterest



* Vertical formats

* Search-driven visual content

* Evergreen graphics

* Strong headlines

Account Managers will handle day-to-day client communication, allowing you to concentrate on strategy and performance.

- Strong, demonstrable experience managing Meta Ads and TikTok Ads.

- Agency experience or equivalent experience managing several accounts simultaneously.

- Experience across ecommerce and lead-generation campaigns; exposure to retail, local services or B2B is advantageous.

- Google Ads experience.

- Experience contributing to landing-page or conversion-rate optimisation.

Looking for an experienced Australian Bookkeeper & Accounts Officer to manage day-to-day finance operations for two internal Australian entities.
